question.text: If $P(x)=a x^2+b x+c$ and $Q(x)=-a x^2+d x+c$ where $a c \neq 0$, then $P(x) \cdot Q(x)=0$ has $(a, b, c, d$ are real)

solution.text:
$\begin{aligned}
& \text { Hint: } D_1=b^2-4 a c \\
& D_2=d^2+4 a c \\
& D_1+D_2=b^2+d^2\gt0 \\
& D_1+D_2\gt0
\end{aligned}$
At least one of $D_1$ or $D_2$ is +ve so at least two real roots
